caption_L1: This bar plot is labeled Share of employment in the private sector in Canada in 2018 , by industry. The x-axis plots Industry while the y-axis measures Share of employment.
caption_L2L3: As it can be observed in the graph retail holds the highest share of employment in the private sector of Canada in 2018 with a value of over 0.15. Retail is followed by manufacturing with a value of around 0.13 and then accommodation and food with a value of around 0.10. Management of companies, utilities, and unclassified businesses hold the lowest shares with values a little over 0.0, whereas the rest of the sectors score within the range of 0.25 to 0.5.
